in_sanskrit.name: अहिल्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who does not move, rooted, immovable, unchangeable

in_marathi.name: Ahilya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahilya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahilya was a celestial nymph, cursed to become a mortal by Mahadev. She was later redeemed and granted immortality.

in_bengali.name: Ahilya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ahilya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ahilya was a celestial nymph, cursed to become a mortal by Mahadev. She was later redeemed and granted immortality.
